biography.plain_text: Joseph T. “Joe” Pregont is a packaging executive and chairman of Prent Corporation. He succeeded his father as president and chief executive in 1985. Pregont then expanded the family's Janesville thermoforming business from one plant into an international manufacturer serving medical, electronics and consumer markets before passing operating leadership to a third generation.

long_biography.plain_text:
Industrial technology studies at UW–Stout gave Pregont formal training in packaging before his appointment at age 26. His father Jack, founder of Prent, remained an adviser after stepping back from daily management. The younger leader concentrated on organic growth, production engineering and a customer-service model, building facilities close to global device-making clusters.

During his tenure, Prent added clean-room operations across Asia, Europe and the Americas, while GOEX developed the plastic-sheet extrusion supporting vertical integration. Pregont also backed packaging education through scholarships, equipment funding and laboratory support at his alma mater. He now chairs the family company as Joseph Pregont II leads its next operating generation.
